SEMESTER EXCHANGE FACTSHEET – 2024 
 
University Name FPT University 
Campus Address   Ho Chi Minh Campus: D1 Street, Saigon Hi-tech Park, Long  
Thanh My Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City 
Contact Person  
Ms. Hien Pham 
International Partnership Coordinator 
Email: hienpt76@fe.edu.vn 
Language of Instruction English 
Period of Exchange  1 semester  
Level of Study Undergraduate 
Recommended Credit 
Load per undergraduate 
semester 
3~5 courses per semester.  
Exchange students can register for a maximum of 5 courses per 
semester. The course list for exchange students is available 01 
month prior to the starting date of the semester.  
Credit transfer  
FPT University is a member of University Mobility Asia Pacific 
(UMAP) and follows the UMAP credit transfer system. Please 
refer to this link (page 10) for details.   
Minimum GPA 
Requirement 
The GPA requirement is up to our partner institution. However, 
we prefer those who have 2.5 (out of 4.0) or above GPA. 
Application Requirements 
Students should be nominated officially by their home institution 
with 6 following documents: 
• English Certificate (if Student does not have certificate at the 
time of application, ask his/her University to write a 
confirmation letter stating that He/She is qualified to study 
abroad) 
• Portrait photo 3x4 cm 
• Academic Official Transcript (English) 
• Copy of Passport 
• Insurance Certificate 
• Recommendation Letter 
Term dates for the 
academic year  
✓ Spring semester: January to April 
✓ Summer semester: May to August 
✓ Fall semester: September to December

Nomination Deadline  
✓ Spring semester: October 01st  
✓ Summer semester: Feb 01st  
✓ Fall semester: June 13th  
Latest Arrival Date Students should arrive at least 03 days before official start date.  
Orientation  Exact date will be notified later. 
Accommodation/  
Housing Options 
The student service team will support students to find a suitable  
accommodation if requested  
Cost of Rent  
(in local currency) Around 450 USD/ month, depending on the type of room   
Living/  
Prospective costs  
Around US$400-600 per month 
It can be different depending on individual’s lifestyle 
Medical Coverage  Students must obtain their medical insurance by themselves 
before they come to Vietnam for the exchange semester.  
Visa Requirements 
Students must obtain Student Visa before coming to Vietnam. 
FPT University will support students with Visa application 
process and students bear the fee.
